Alex’s day unfolded with steady discipline and cautious engagement, buffered by strong manager support that elevated her psychological safety amid recurring conflicts. The day’s texture was one of balancing internal tension from conflict and external demands with a quiet determination to maintain harmony and deliver quality work.
